rules.guidance: Use try-with-resources for owned AutoCloseable resources so exceptional paths also close them. Check ownership before closing caller-owned resources.
Bind untrusted SQL values with PreparedStatement parameters rather than concatenating them into SQL. Identifiers require a separate allowlist.
Prefer an argument sequence without a shell for subprocess calls. If shell interpretation is necessary, establish and test a safe input contract before passing untrusted text.
Default argument objects are shared across calls. For per-call mutable state, use a sentinel such as None and construct the object inside the function.
Use strict equality when implicit conversion is not part of the intended contract. Test values of different types before replacing intentional coercion.
With strictNullChecks, handle possibly null or undefined values explicitly. A non-null assertion does not add a runtime check; validate the value when the contract requires it.
